paragraphs.text: The Patron of the Moon is a kami from Kamigawa that was active during the Kami War . It is the great Patron Kami of the Soratami .

The kami's appearance is that of a giant furry serpent, with face masks lining its hide. It has the warped face of a rabbit , mantis-like scythe arms, enormous wings, and giant pestles floating around its head. It is known to eat Soratami as offerings.
